name: L'automne
source:
At 32, it's no understatement to say Corey's life is going less-than ideal. With both the company he worked for, as well as his recent relationship breaking, we find Corey hurt and looking to regain a sense of normalcy in his life. Deciding that spending time with his family may help him center, he flies back to the sleepy college town he grew up in. What will he find when he gets back to his home turf? Well, anything can happen when the leaves start to fall.

[From [url=https://the-bjakery.itch.io/lautomne]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
32岁的科里，可以毫不夸张地说，他的生活并不理想。无论是他工作的公司，还是他最近的关系破裂，我们都发现科里受到了伤害，并希望恢复正常的生活。他决定与家人共度时光可以帮助他集中注意力，于是他飞回了他长大的那个沉睡的大学城。当他回到家乡时，他会发现什么？好吧，当树叶开始落下时，任何事情都有可能发生。

[来自[url=https://the-bjakery.itch.io/lautomne]Itch.io[/url]]
